# Odd song details in the top bar and on the Record card, fix/bar119 (1280x720, GUI scale 3 = 426x240 unless said),
# played through the demo song with the test hook's "song <title> | <artist>" (made-up names; \uXXXX is that letter).
# The bar shows the song's name all the time here (Lyrics in the bar off, Only on song change off), and the card sits
# in the bottom right with its lyric strip. Each shot, branch against the old code:
# 1. bar119-english-bar: "Paper Lanterns  ·  Mira Vale  ·  Demo", the usual look (the same on both).
#    bar119-arabic-bar: an Arabic title, then "·  Mira Vale  ·  Demo". With the old code there is a wide empty gap
#    (about 15 GUI units, 45 pixels) between the end of the Arabic title (it starts on the left) and the "·", and the
#    bar is that much wider. On the branch the "·" follows the title after the usual two spaces, as on the English shot.
# 2. bar119-arabic-card: the Record card with a longer Arabic title, an Arabic artist and an Arabic lyric line. With the
#    old code the title is cut short with "…" although it fits, and the line under it is off the strip's middle: it
#    sits too far left, its left end (the end of the sentence) cut off for the first part of each 4-second line, then
#    slides right until it is whole against the left side. On the branch the whole title shows, and the whole line sits
#    still in the middle of the strip.
# 3. bar119-emoji: "Paper Hearts" and a heart, by "Mira Vale" and sparkles, each emoji with the selector phones add for
#    colour (VS16). With the old code a dashed box with "VS16" in it follows the heart and the sparkles, in the bar and on
#    the card (title and artist). On the branch there are no boxes.
# 4. bar119-long-gui4: GUI scale 4 (320x180), a long English title and artist: the bar's title ends in "…" inside the
#    bar and the card's title and artist end in "…" inside the card; nothing runs out (the same on both: checked, fine).
# Run it, and with -f mod_ref=<the branch's first commit, the test hook alone> to compare with the old code:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/bar119 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/bar119.txt

cmd time set noon
cmd weather clear
look 0 -20
guiscale 3
set barLyrics false
set hudOnlyOnChange false
set recordCard true
set cardLyrics true
set cardLines 1
set cardCorner BOTTOM_RIGHT
sleep 6

song Paper Lanterns | Mira Vale
sleep 3
shot bar119-english-bar

song سلام يا قطة خضراء | Mira Vale
sleep 3
shot bar119-arabic-bar

song سلام يا قطة خضراء في الليل | فرقة الأقمار السبعة
sleep 2
lines نمشي معا تحت ضوء القمر الهادئ في الليل
sleep 3
shot bar119-arabic-card

song Paper Hearts ❤️ | Mira Vale ✨️
sleep 3
shot bar119-emoji

guiscale 4
song A Very Long Made Up Song Title That Keeps Going Past The Bar | Mira Vale, The Glass Tide Orchestra & Friends
sleep 3
shot bar119-long-gui4

song
